preconditions.description: n is an integer within the range from 1 to 100
m is an integer within the range from 1 to 100

postconditions.description: The size of the beautiful set of points is equal to k

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All x-coordinates of the points are within the range from 0 to n

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= m for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All y-coordinates of the points are within the range from 0 to m

postconditions.expression: all(x + y > 0 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: The sum of each point's x and y coordinates is greater than 0

postconditions.expression: all(all((x2 - x1)**2 + (y2 - y1)**2 not in (2**0.5, 3**0.5, 5**0.5, ...) for x2, y2 in points) for x1, y1 in points)
postconditions.description: The distance between any two points is not an integer
